response.sql: WITH per_race AS (SELECT r.raceId AS raceId, r.name AS name, AVG(cr.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(*) AS result_count FROM constructorResults cr JOIN races r ON r.raceId = cr.raceId WHERE cr.points > 1.0 GROUP BY r.raceId, r.name), with_name AS (SELECT raceId, name, avg_points, result_count, AVG(avg_points) OVER (PARTITION BY name) AS name_avg FROM per_race) SELECT raceId, name, avg_points, result_count, CASE WHEN name_avg IS NULL OR name_avg = 0 THEN NULL ELSE avg_points * 1.0 / name_avg END AS ratio FROM with_name ORDER BY (CASE WHEN name_avg IS NULL OR name_avg = 0 THEN NULL ELSE avg_points * 1.0 / name_avg END) IS NULL, ratio DESC, raceId LIMIT 10
